The configuration section handler no longer attempts to merge the configuration hiearchy when loading from app.config.
It instead returns the configuration from all levels of the hierarchy, and leaves it up to the configuration parsers to do the merging.
The full power of this will be realized when the configuration parsers allow you to override settings for plugins that have already been configured.
